instruction: Fix `url_decode` in `codec/url.py` so a '+' is decoded as a space (form encoding). It currently uses `unquote`, which leaves '+' untouched instead of treating it as a space.
gold_patch:
diff --git a/codec/url.py b/codec/url.py
--- a/codec/url.py
+++ b/codec/url.py
@@ -10,7 +10,7 @@
 
 def url_decode(text: str) -> str:
     """Decode percent-encoded form data, turning '+' into a space."""
-    return unquote(text)
+    return unquote_plus(text)
